projects.name: Operations & Processing Transformation
details: • Analyzing requirements and business processes across payment operations and end-to-end payment lifecycle, including payment initiation,
authentication, authorization, validation, routing, transaction processing, payment status tracking (successful/failed/pending), reversals, refunds,
chargebacks, exceptions, reconciliation, and settlement across UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, cards, and international cross-border payments (SWIFT).
• Contributed to Target Operating Model (TOM) definition and payment operating model enhancements by evaluating current-state processes,
designing future-state workflows, aligning business capabilities, operating procedures, and system interactions to support scalable payment
operations and digital transformation initiatives.
• Conducting AS-IS/TO-BE analysis, identifying process gaps, and documenting BRDs, Functional Requirements, business rules, process flows, user
stories, acceptance criteria, and API requirements for payment-related enhancements involving payment gateways, payment processors, PSPs,
issuer/acquirer banks, core banking systems (CBS), merchant systems, and payment networks (NPCI, Visa, Mastercard, and SWIFT).
• Collaborating with business, operations, product, technology, QA, and compliance stakeholders to clarify requirements, analyse system integrations,
API dependencies, data flows, payment interfaces, notification services, fraud/AML checks, reconciliation and settlement systems, support SIT/UAT,
validate payment scenarios, and manage defects through successful delivery.
